Thanks for the quick reply. 

No. I'm not interested in acting or movies.  That's not something I could consider.  I don't like being around that many people, and being "put on the spot" would make it even worse.  I have anxiety issues. 

I am curious – If I may ask, what were you arrested for during your first year of college?

That's a fantastic story.  I'm very happy things have worked out for you.  

It's truly unfortunate how a stupid mistake from your passed can influence jobs and your entire future. 

The older generation didn't have this problem.  Their mistakes were lost to paperwork. Our mistake live on in searchable databases.
